#CratePartner My friends at @crateandbarrel sent me their exclusive @allclad 10-piece D3 Stainless Steel Cookware Set and asked me to recreate the French Onion Soup-inspired chicken I served at the first Kiko’s pop-up. Lucky they did because I have NOT stopped thinking about it since I made it. All-Clad pans have been my go-to since 2008 when I started my cooking competitions. They’re reliable, super even, and quick to heat up! This dish is creamy, crispy, and luxurious and just goes to show you what good cookware is made for!

For the chicken:
4 large airline chicken breasts
2 oz shredded gruyere, baked until crispy
½ cup toasted panko
1 stick room temperature butter
2 tablespoons chives
1 teaspoon onion powder
Salt and pepper to taste

For the Soubise:
2 tablespoons butter
1 large sweet onions, julienned
1 teaspoon onion powder
Salt to taste
2 teaspoons flour
1 sprig thyme
¼ teaspoon white pepper
1 cup whole milk
